comment: Synthetic history for scripts/live-demo.sh. Every project, provider and number is invented.

arguments.decision: Store money as integer minor units with an ISO 4217 currency code
arguments.rationale: Integer arithmetic has no rounding drift, and every client language reads it the same way.
alternatives: Floating point amounts: rejected because binary fractions drift on repeated addition
Decimal strings: rejected because every consumer would need its own parsing rules

arguments.decision: Publish ledger events through a transactional outbox
arguments.rationale: The event row commits with the ledger row, so a broker outage cannot lose an event.
alternatives: Dual write to the database and the broker: rejected because a crash between writes loses events
Change data capture on the ledger table: rejected because it couples consumers to the schema

arguments.decision: Process payment webhooks synchronously inside the HTTP request
arguments.rationale: It is the smallest thing that works at launch volume.
alternatives: Queue from day one: rejected as premature at launch volume

arguments.decision: Acknowledge payment webhooks fast and process them from a queue
arguments.rationale: The provider times out at 10 seconds, and synchronous processing missed that under load.
alternatives: Keep synchronous webhook processing: rejected because timeouts trigger provider retries

arguments.contextSummary: The webhook queue consumer is merged. Duplicate webhook deliveries are not handled yet.
openLoops: Provider retries can deliver the same payment webhook twice
arguments.nextAction: Decide how to deduplicate webhook deliveries before the refund handler ships

arguments.decision: Generate the webhook reference pages from the OpenAPI file
arguments.rationale: Generated webhook pages cannot drift from the published duplicate delivery contract.
alternatives: Hand-written webhook pages: rejected because they go stale
